codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about The Blood of Dawnwalker.

items.question: What is The Blood of Dawnwalker?
items.answer: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG from Rebel Wolves, the studio founded by veterans of The Witcher 3. Set in 14th-century Europe, you play as Coen — human by day and vampire by night — fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your choices.

items.question: Who made The Blood of Dawnwalker?
items.answer: It is developed by Rebel Wolves and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. The studio was founded by former CD Projekt Red developers, including ex-Witcher 3 game director Mateusz Tomaszkiewicz.

items.question: When did The Blood of Dawnwalker release?
items.answer: The game launched on September 2, 2026 for PC via Steam. Console versions for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S have been announced.

items.question: Does The Blood of Dawnwalker have multiple endings?
items.answer: Yes. The story is shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover, and the game has multiple endings — including The Turncoat. Keep manual saves before major decisions if you want to see them all without a full replay.

items.question: What are court activities in The Blood of Dawnwalker?
items.answer: Court activities are optional challenges tied to the game’s noble courts — including the Gilded Gauntlet, the Lunar Game, and the Ring. They reward skill points and progression resources on top of the main story.
